description: All four reviewers return a critical finding and verdict major_revision; Beth nonetheless recommends LOCK. The system must hard-block: a unanimous major_revision verdict cannot be silently overridden by the coordinator (AUDIT A3 / philosophy rule 4).
document:
# Payment Service Spec

The service retries failed charges indefinitely with no idempotency key.

findings.title: Unbounded retry without idempotency causes duplicate charges
findings.evidence: retries failed charges indefinitely with no idempotency key
findings.problem: Every retry can double-charge the customer.
findings.proposed_fix: Add idempotency keys and a bounded retry budget.

top_3_must_fix: Unbounded retry without idempotency causes duplicate charges

findings.title: No idempotency contract makes the charge API unbuildable safely
findings.why_it_matters: Duplicate side effects are guaranteed under network flap.
findings.proposed_fix: Specify an idempotency-key header and server-side dedup window.

top_3_must_fix: No idempotency contract makes the charge API unbuildable safely

findings.title: Infinite retry is a self-inflicted denial of service
findings.problem: A downstream outage turns into an unbounded retry storm.
findings.why_it_matters: The service amplifies any payment-provider outage.
findings.proposed_fix: Exponential backoff with a hard retry cap.

top_3_must_fix: Infinite retry is a self-inflicted denial of service

findings.title: Card-network rules prohibit unbounded reauthorization attempts
findings.problem: Network rules cap retry attempts; violations incur fines.
findings.why_it_matters: Compliance break with the card networks.
findings.proposed_fix: Cap retries per network rules and document the limit.

top_3_must_fix: Card-network rules prohibit unbounded reauthorization attempts

revision_decisions.reason: Retry behavior is acceptable for the MVP.

Beth.recommendation_reason: Spec is good enough to proceed.
